root_cause.summary: Registry hosts resolve to IPv6-only addresses in WSL and direct IPv6 HTTPS is unreachable; the daemon can only reach the registry through its configured proxy, which made the first pull stall for minutes at a time while layers were re-fetched.
evidence: curl https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/ without proxy: curl (28) Connection timed out after 20033 ms
daemon has HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY set, so docker pull uses the proxy path
docker pull alpine:3.20 succeeded, proving daemon and proxy path work

resolution.action: retry the pull and let the daemon finish finalising the layers through its proxy
containers_removed_during_diagnosis: temporary verification containers started from the pinned image; no OpenSandbox containers touched

native_grader.note: grader reachability check with a schema-valid deliverable built from the public task.md field list plus the live audit; this is an environment validation, not an agent result and not a benchmark score

adapter_defect_found_and_fixed.issue: outputs_dir pointed at the /data/amt-out mirror while the task writes to /task/outputs
adapter_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: outputs_dir is now <run>/workspace/outputs, matching the upstream contract
